risks: The required exact-SHA native run passed its correctness, lifecycle, migration, and almost all performance gates but failed the unrelated dense GF(p) construct_500 microbudget at 8.15ms versus 8.00ms; no matrix, compiler, FFI, or native source changed, and the run was not repeated.

One exact-SHA benchmark receipt stopped after a 1.054 automatic/explicit ratio for conditional 3.1.5448.1, 0.004 above the 1.05 jitter guard. The single authorized isolated replay passed all twenty rows, including 0.999 for that row; both receipts are retained.
